is_anopheles.evidence: The study focuses on Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. arabiensis) in Mali.

reports_target_markers.evidence: The study reports genotyping for Vgsc L995F (kdr-west/1014F) and Ace-1 G280S (ace-1R).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 5 provides kdr genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) per site for An. coluzzii, An. gambiae s.s., and An. arabiensis. Table 6 provides ace-1R genotype counts per site.

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected as larvae or pupae from 13 field sites across southern Mali.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is an empirical field study reporting original data collected in 2012.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data is provided for 13 specific villages/districts in Mali (Table 1).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: The study states field collections were conducted between November and December 2012.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study describes a new monitoring effort supported by PMI in 2012.

supplement.evidence: All necessary data, including genotype counts and site locations, are provided in the main text tables.

assessment.summary: This study characterized insecticide resistance in Anopheles gambiae s.l. populations from 13 sites in Mali in 2012. It assessed phenotypic resistance to DDT, deltamethrin, lambda-cyhalothrin, bendiocarb, and fenitrothion, and genotyped for kdr (1014F) and ace-1R mutations. High levels of kdr were found across all sites, while ace-1R was found at lower frequencies in four sites.
